title: Make an identical note retry in the same session replay even after the item's planning fields changed
outcome: Make an identical note retry in the same session replay even after the item's planning fields changed
acceptance: A keyless note retried with identical text and refs by the same session on the same item and claim epoch returns the original receipt, with no second note, even when a label, title or priority of the item changed between the two calls
A note with different text, from a different session, or under a different claim fence is still recorded as a new note

The supported way to learn a note's outcome after a lost response is documented in one place: read `show REF --notes` (or `search` for its text) and retry only if absent; behaviour tests cover the retry cases through the public words
